name: freshbliss
description: FreshBliss: Firebase backend (firebase/) and Next.js storefront (web/). This file only holds the one-command local startup.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names backend,seed,web,warm --prefix-colors cyan,yellow,magenta,gray "cd firebase && npm run emulators" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:8080 && cd firebase && npm run seed" "cd web && npm run dev" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:8080 && node web/scripts/warm-dev.mjs"
